text:
jamie: deploy-bot just paused the payments canary — says values/chart mismatch across regions, are we seeing this in prod canaries?

deploy-bot: automated: Canary halted for service=payments-service; reason=values_checksum_mismatch; region=eu-west != us-west; detected chart versions: eu-west=redwood/payments@1.3.3, us-west=redwood/payments@1.3.2. Suggested action: manual reconcile or pin values.

lee_ops: hmm. change window ends in ~45m. do we want to rollback eu-west to 1.3.2 or pin us-west to 1.3.3?

carmen: prefer rollback eu-west to match stable canary (1.3.2) then re-run canary. pinning across regions will hide config drift. also someone should update release notes & mention the drift.

sre-oncall: agree w/ carmen. Manual rollback steps: 
```
# rollback to previous stable image and chart
helm upgrade payments-service redwood/payments --namespace prod --set image.tag=1.3.2 --reuse-values --wait
# or if using revision-based rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/payments-service -n prod --to-revision=3
```
Run smoke after helm succeeds: `curl -fS http://payments.prod.internal/health || exit 1`

jamie: @lee_ops can you take eu-west rollback? i'll update the release notes once it's green. @deploy-bot leave canary paused until we confirm.

lee_ops: starting rollback now. will post status. :wrench:

devex-bot: suggested changelog snippet: "Reverted payments-service chart in eu-west to 1.3.2 to reconcile cross-region values drift. Monitoring ongoing." Link: https://git.company/release-notes/2026-03

carmen: added a small entry to the release-notes draft and flagged the security/config team to audit values templating.

deploy-bot: automated: Rollback triggered by @lee_ops for region=eu-west. Tracking job id=rb-202603-77. Canary remains paused.

lee_ops: helm upgrade finished, image tag set to 1.3.2, pods in eu-west back to ready. smoke check: OK. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: automated: Rollback complete for eu-west. Canary resumed in eu-west on chart=1.3.2. us-west unchanged. Monitoring window: 10m.

sre-oncall: follow-up: create a pipeline preflight that compares values checksum across regions before canary and fails fast. filing ticket INF-4592 for this.

jamie: solid. @carmen please add the release-notes snippet to the final notes and mention the rollback rationale. We should also schedule a retro on templating drift in next weekly infra sync. :thumbsup:

carmen: on it — will merge notes and assign INF-4592 to infra next sprint.

lee_ops: closing loop here. if anything flares in the 10m monitor i'll reopen.

sre-oncall: noted, marking postmortem not required unless regression reappears.

jamie: thanks everyone. closing thread.
